extension.description: Scrobbles your Kodi playback to your self-hosted Chronicle server, and syncs ratings, artwork, and watch counts both ways. Chronicle is the source of truth for ratings and art (always pushed to Kodi); play counts and last-played dates reconcile in whichever direction has the more recent watch. Covers movies, movie collections, TV shows, and individual episodes. Supports resetting Kodi watch progress for a fresh rewatch while keeping your full history safe in Chronicle.
extension.news: v2.0.5 - Fix: the Chronicle URL field was silently missing from the Connection settings page (only API Key showed). It combined an empty <default/> with <allowempty>false</allowempty> -- a combination none of Kodi's own bundled add-ons use (empty defaults always pair with allowempty=true there) -- which made Kodi drop just that one setting from the rendered page instead of erroring. Changed to allowempty=true; the addon's own code already requires a non-empty URL before doing anything. v2.0.4 - Fix: "This add-on can't be configured" when opening Settings. settings.xml used version="2" with default="..." attributes and no <level> element per setting -- this Kodi build only recognizes the version="1" schema with <default> as a child element and a required <level> child (confirmed against Kodi's own bundled metadata.tvshows.themoviedb.org.python and audioencoder.kodi.builtin.aac add-ons, both version="1"). Kodi silently treated the whole file as having no settings rather than raising a parse error. v2.0.3 - Fix: addon showed Kodi's generic fallback icon instead of the Chronicle "C" in the add-on browser. icon.png was present at the addon root but never declared via an <assets> block, which this Kodi build requires explicitly rather than auto-detecting a root-level icon.png (confirmed against script.simkl.scrobbler's own addon.xml, which does declare it). v2.0.2 - Fix: opening the addon before it's configured now jumps straight to Settings (server URL + Connect to Chronicle), matching SIMKL Scrobbler's first-run behavior, instead of showing an action menu whose entries would all fail with nothing configured yet. v2.0.1 - Fix: remove the xbmc.gui dependency declaration — it's not a real resolvable addon on modern Kodi (GUI functionality ships bundled with xbmc.python), and declaring it caused every install attempt to fail with "dependency on xbmc.gui version 5.14.0 could not be satisfied". v2.0.0 - Bidirectional sync: ratings + art (Chronicle -> Kodi, source of truth) and play count / last-played reconciliation (whichever side is more recent wins) for movies, movie collections, TV shows, and episodes. Scrobbling resolves/creates the Chronicle media item automatically when Chronicle hasn't matched it yet. v1.1.0 - QR code device authentication; sync Chronicle lists to Kodi playlists v1.0.0 - Initial release
